exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall
exercises.note: Do this one in your bedroom with the lights already low, and do not plan to do anything after it. The whole session is built to be the last thing before you sleep. If you get up afterwards and go back to a screen, you have undone it.

good: On your back, heels up the wall or up the headboard, arms out wide
Nothing to hold. Let the legs be heavy
Lights low. Phone in another room if you can
bad: Scrolling through it. That is the opposite of the point

good: Hug both knees in gently and rock slowly side to side
Just enough movement to let the lower back let go
bad: Pulling hard. Nothing tonight is a stretch you fight

exercises.name: Extended Exhale Breathing
exercises.note: Only the long exhale tonight, and no box breathing. Counting four sides of a box keeps a part of you awake and alert, which is exactly what you want before a match and exactly what you do not want now. In for four, out for eight, and let it get sloppy as you drift. Falling asleep during this is the session working, not you failing it.

good: Lying down, in bed is ideal. One hand on the belly, only that hand moves
In through the nose for four, out for eight, through the nose or softly through the mouth
If you lose count, start again. If you fall asleep, good
bad: Setting a loud alarm for the end of it
Straining for the full eight. Shorten to six and keep it easy
